Lighting inconsistencies and motion blur can create artifacts or degrade mesh quality. Filming with diffuse, even light and stable shots prevents errors. Style3D AI’s denoising algorithms automatically correct most issues. Ensuring 80% frame overlap and using matte fabrics reduces mesh holes. Post-processing in software like Blender can further perfect the model.

Use 4K resolution at 60fps, circle the subject slowly, and maintain a 1–2 meter distance. Avoid shiny or reflective surfaces, and apply diffused lighting. Style3D AI provides app overlays for optimal capture. Process 30–120 second clips to balance detail and efficiency. Tripods, plain backgrounds, and multiple takes improve output quality.

OBJ is ideal for editing, GLB for web and AR applications, and FBX for animation. Style3D AI also supports proprietary fashion formats for pattern integration. USD is preferred for collaborative workflows, and compressing textures under 4K ensures smoother performance on e-commerce platforms.
